form:FormGroup.label: Expression
form:FormGroup.helpText: Selects the streams this filter processes, using stream meta fields such as Feed and Type.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Streams matching this expression are processed.

form:FormGroup.label: Min Create Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: Only process streams created at or after this date and time. Leave blank for no lower limit. Use ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2024-01-31T00:00:00.000Z.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: ISO 8601 date and time; blank for no lower limit.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Create Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: Only process streams created at or before this date and time. Leave blank for no upper limit. Use ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2024-12-31T23:59:59.999Z.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: ISO 8601 date and time; blank for no upper limit.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Processing Tasks
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum number of this filter's tasks that can be processed at the same time across the cluster. Set to 0 for no limit. Default is 0. A processing profile, if selected, takes precedence over this limit.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: 0 means no limit. A processing profile overrides this.

form:FormGroup.label: Processing Profile
form:FormGroup.helpText: The processing profile that controls when, and on which nodes, this filter's tasks run and how many run at once. Choose [ none ] to use Max Processing Tasks instead.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Controls when, where and how many tasks run; none uses Max Processing Tasks.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick to give this filter its own maximum task creation delay instead of the cluster-wide limit. Useful for filters that must react quickly to data that only arrives occasionally.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, the cluster-wide limit is used.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Task Creation Delay
form:FormGroup.helpText: The longest this filter waits between checks for new data after checks that found none. Lower values pick up new data sooner but check more often. Default is 30 seconds. The cluster-wide limit is 1 minute by default.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Longest wait between checks for new data. Default is 30 seconds.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick to include this processor filter when its pipeline is exported. Default is unticked.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Exported with its pipeline when ticked.

form:FormGroup.label: Run As User
form:FormGroup.helpText: The user whose permissions are used when this filter's processing runs. Default is you, for a new filter.
Opens a dialog to set the feeds this filter must wait for and the minimum and maximum processing delays.
